title: Fifty Shades Darker
author: E.L. James
summary: Anastasia Steele and Christian Grey try to rebuild their relationship on her terms after a painful break. Old shadows from his past and a jealous figure from it threaten the reunion.
readIf: you want an explicit, melodramatic romance sequel that picks up straight after the first book.
skipIf: you dislike controlling love interests or want subtle, realistic writing about relationships.
